tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background in both themes, under the dot grid. ink, ink-2 and ink-muted read on it. christmas-night: evergreen night page under the scene; ink 8.8:1, gold 6.3:1.

tokens.name: page-dots
tokens.usage: The page's dot grid: 1.5px dots on a 24px pitch. Decoration only. christmas-night: no dot grid, the scene replaces it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The one cream: panels, card faces, pills and the reaction ring. Never introduce a second cream. christmas-night: frosted glass, white at 12% over the scene with a 6px backdrop blur; ink 6.3:1, ink-2 5.1:1, gold 4.5:1 (right at the limit: gold on glass only for links, labels and icons, never small body text).

tokens.name: panel-inner
tokens.usage: Inner surfaces inside a panel, info notes, and the wordmark mark's face. christmas-night: a darker glass inset (ink 8.2:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Field fill and the white pill. Also the label on an action fill (see on-action). christmas-night: the field fill is a dark inset, not white (ink 9.2:1).

tokens.name: bed-rim
tokens.usage: The pet bed's rim, the darkest warm. Three warm steps separate page, cushion and rim.

tokens.name: bed-cushion
tokens.usage: The pet bed's cushion. Pet coats sit two steps darker than it. ink reads on it.

tokens.name: bed-ring
tokens.usage: The inset ring on the cushion.

tokens.name: bed-drop
tokens.usage: Soft drop under the pet bed and under reaction buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default border for panels, cards and fields. Decorative weight (1.65:1 on panel); meaning never rides on it alone. christmas-night: 55% white, 3.3:1 on glass, so field edges pass 3:1.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers inside panels.

tokens.name: border-ring
tokens.usage: The bed's dashed inner ring. The only dashed line in boo; UI borders are always solid.

tokens.name: border-neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral pill and chip borders (new round, burrow code, seat them) and the waiting CTA.

tokens.name: border-neutral-hover
tokens.usage: Hover border for neutral pills and chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on page, panel, panel-inner and bed-cushion (13:1 on panel). christmas-night: cream.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and neutral pill labels on panel and highlight (9:1 on panel).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Muted text on page and panel (5.3:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: 11px notes and captions on page and panel. Misses 4.5:1 (3.96:1); kept as the source has it, use only for non-essential notes. christmas-night: passes 4.5:1 here (5.1:1 on glass).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and the waiting CTA label. 3.2:1 on panel: never for text that must be read. christmas-night: 4.2:1 on glass, still only for placeholders and the waiting pill.

tokens.name: icon-warm
tokens.usage: Warm icon tint inside info notes.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The action colour: primary CTA fill, leading pill icons, the wordmark mark, your own card's paw. Christmas: evergreen. In pawker, white on it is 3.3:1, short of 4.5:1 for the 16px CTA label; christmas passes (5.0:1). christmas-night: gold. Also the focus ring colour in this theme.

tokens.name: action-dark
tokens.usage: Primary CTA border and its flat shadow.

tokens.name: action-ink
tokens.usage: Labels on share/join pills and action chips, on panel (6.1:1) and action-tint (4.9:1). Christmas 9.3:1 and 7.5:1.

tokens.name: action-tint
tokens.usage: Action chip fill, share pill hover, wordmark mark shadow.

tokens.name: action-tint-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on action-tint surfaces. christmas-night: no separate hover step, same as action-tint.

tokens.name: action-border
tokens.usage: Share/join pill borders, chip borders and the focused field border.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action fill. christmas-night: dark ink on the gold CTA (9.0:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Highlight: the watching chip and butter accents. ink-2 reads on it (6.8:1). Christmas: gold.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Small accent marks, the heart reaction's ring. Christmas: berry red, never used to carry meaning against action green.

tokens.name: confetti
tokens.usage: Confetti gold on celebrations.

tokens.name: warm13-bg
tokens.usage: Subtle warm fill: the 13 card and an empty required field.

tokens.name: warm13-border
tokens.usage: Border for warm13-bg.

tokens.name: warm13-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warm13-bg (4.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Leave pill and shoo chip borders.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Leave labels (hop out, shoo) on panel. 4.07:1 in pawker, kept as the source has it; christmas brick 5.9:1. Always a word, never colour alone. christmas-night: pale coral 5.4:1 on glass.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Hover fill on leave pills and chips.

tokens.name: flat-shadow
tokens.usage: Colour of the flat offset shadow under panels and step cards.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay scrim over a live room. christmas-night: a deep pine scrim behind sheets.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets. In pawker and christmas the same as panel. christmas-night: solid, never glass, so a dialog reads over a busy screen (ink 7.3:1).

tokens.name: snow

tokens.name: berry
